title: Applications of Ti/TiO2 nanotube arrays/CeO2@PbO2 and Ti/β-PbO2-CuOx electrodes for efficient electrocatalytic degradation of paraquat: cell design and comprehensive mechanistic studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39148-39160

Ti/TiO2 nanotube arrays (NTA)/CeO2@PbO2 and Ti/β-PbO2-CuOx electrodes were used for the electrocatalytic degradation of paraquat (PQ2+), a highly toxic and widely used herbicide.
